mods.description: This addon fixes the front sight position when aiming and corrects animations for certain weapons that caused issues in original Stalker Call of Pripyat and when playing with the IX-Ray Engine. It's designed to fix original weapon bugs.

mods.title: SWR addon v0.95
mods.description: The sensational Stalker Weapon Reanimation bursts onto IX-Ray. Sure, the weapons here may be clunky, angular, with messed-up smoothing and crooked bumps, but they fully capture the spirit of post-Soviet postmodernism — now also featuring the awesome animations of GWR and IWP.
